items.title: "I'm not giving it to the kid!": Dodgers fan keeps NLDS foul ball
items.summary: During Game 3 of the Dodgers-Braves NLDS in Atlanta, a Dodgers fan in a Yoshinobu Yamamoto jersey caught a foul ball, ignored chants of "Give it to the kid!" and shrugged at the camera: "I'm sorry, I can't! I'm not giving it to the kid!" The camera then cut to a crestfallen young Braves fan. The clip came from TikTok user @the_hammyshow, and one X repost passed 2.6 million views in about 12 hours. It set off a nationwide foul-ball etiquette debate and plenty of jokes about the shrug.

items.title: Amanda Seyfried's Joni Mitchell cover gets Ghostfaced by her daughter
items.summary: On October 6, Amanda Seyfried posted a Reel of herself singing Joni Mitchell's "A Case of You" on a dulcimer while her 9-year-old daughter crept up behind her in a Scream Ghostface mask. Seyfried spotted her in the camera and screamed, and the song ended there. The clip passed 54,000 likes within hours, drew laughing reactions from celebrity friends and even the official Scream account, and fans begged to hear the rest of the song.

items.title: Renter scrapes painted-over keys off a door frame; Coraline jokes ensue
items.summary: TikToker Tori (@torihudsonn_) filmed herself prying two long-lost bedroom keys off the top of a door frame, where the landlord had painted right over them. The clip passed five million views. Commenters flooded it with Coraline and Locke & Key warnings not to open any small doors, plus "landlord special" jokes.
